result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visual/usability concerns: bottom navigation appears to collide with the system gesture area, horizontal lists rely on clipped edge content, and some icon-only controls may be hard to understand or operate.

issues.description: The bottom navigation sits very close to the system gesture indicator area, and the dark gesture bar visually overlaps/crowds the center nav icons, making the tab bar look cramped or struck-through.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding and increase separation between the system gesture indicator and the app tab bar; verify on Android gesture navigation and iOS home-indicator devices.

issues.description: Horizontally scrolling sections such as categories and 'Fastest near you' show items clipped at the right edge with limited visual affordance beyond the partial card/chip.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle edge fade, scroll indicator, or more consistent peek width so users clearly understand the row continues.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons and bottom navigation icons are icon-only and may not expose clear labels to screen readers or users who rely on visible text.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar', 'Search', 'Cart', and 'Profile', and consider visible labels or larger touch targets for bottom navigation.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and restaurant details uses light gray coloring that may be difficult to read in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text toward WCAG AA while preserving the visual hierarchy.
